_revenue_note: No price set (docs/BRIEF.md: 'Free for now', Stripe is Phase 1.5). monetize cheap-side default used: GBP 3 per paying user per month, 3% of MAU.
_price_note: Priced on 2026-10-25 from references/cost-model.md order-of-magnitude ranges, converted to GBP at ~0.8/USD. LLM and Mux lines have no reference range; they are stated assumptions (Opus-class ~GBP 12/M input, 60/M output tokens; Mux ~GBP 0.001 per minute streamed) and are the first numbers to verify.

components.name: Web + API compute
components.provider: Vercel (Next.js 16 serverless, region lhr1; apps/web/vercel.json, docs/DEPLOY.md)
components.note: Hobby -> Pro seat -> Pro + ~50M invocations -> Pro + ~480M invocations/month with multi-second AI and DB handlers (GB-hours dominate)

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.provider: Neon (docs/DEPLOY.md; plain Postgres 16 over postgres.js, packages/db/src/index.ts)
components.note: Free -> 2vCPU/8GB -> 4vCPU/16GB -> 8vCPU/32GB + read replica + ~1 TB of rows (exercise_instance, health_sample, ai_log)

components.name: Progress photos stored as bytea in Postgres
components.note: managed Postgres storage ~GBP 0.10-0.20 per GB-month; object storage would be ~0.012

components.name: LLM: weekly letter to every profile
components.provider: Anthropic claude-opus-5 (apps/web/app/api/cron/weekly/route.ts loops ALL profiles; ~1.6k in / 0.3k out per call, 4.33 calls per registered user per month)
components.note: assumed Opus-class GBP 12/M input, 60/M output; system prompt cached

components.name: LLM: coach chat, free to all
components.provider: Anthropic claude-opus-5 (packages/api/src/services/coach.ts; ~3k context + 0.2k out, assumed 8 messages per MAU per month; BILLING_ENFORCED unset so no gating)

components.name: LLM: intake follow-ups, extraction, summary, programme note
components.provider: Anthropic claude-opus-5 (packages/api/src/ai/tasks.ts; ~18 calls per new user, amortised over 12 months)

components.name: LLM: body-photo analysis + meal photo/text estimates
components.provider: Anthropic claude-opus-5 vision (analyseBodyPhotos, estimateMeal; assumed 0.3 photo sets + 5 meal estimates per MAU per month)

components.name: Video streaming
components.provider: Mux (@mux/mux-player-react; assumed 0.5 min per DAU per day at ~GBP 0.001/min; YouTube embeds are free)

components.name: Wearable provider APIs
components.provider: Oura, Whoop, Strava, Fitbit, Garmin, Polar OAuth (packages/integrations); free developer tiers, Garmin/Polar need partner approval

components.name: Redis
components.provider: docker-compose.yml defines redis:7 but no code imports a Redis client; not deployed (docs/DEPLOY.md: 'Redis is not required')

components.name: Observability
components.provider: PostHog + Sentry env vars exist but no SDK is imported; priced as if wired (hosted free tiers then usage)
